title: UNDER THE GATE Episode 13 Indonesia, English Sub
description:
English

Watch as a young Soul Summoner stands against the evil Nine Chrysanthemum Sect after the Border Gate collapses, fighting to protect the people of Lan Hai. In this world, all consciousness is made up of microscopic particles. Lin Ye, a young man from Lan Hai, is born with the rare constitution of a Soul Summoner, making him the ultimate "human host" in the world of wandering souls. Constantly possessed by spirits, he finds himself caught in one disaster after another, always running from trouble.After meeting Chen Guo, a girl with the supernatural ability to subdue wandering souls, Lin Ye joins the supernatural organization of Hua Jing Academy and becomes entangled in a century-long conflict with the evil Nine Chrysanthemum Sect from Eastern Japan.Along the way, he suffers repeated betrayals that shatter his trust. Then, as the Border Gate is about to open and the entire city faces destruction, Lin Ye gathers his resolve, confronts a perfect clone of himself, and fights to the death to protect Lan Hai.But just as the great battle comes to an end and the heroes have fallen, a new conspiracy by the Nine Chrysanthemum Sect quietly begins to unfold deep within Kunlun...

Indonesia

Saksikan bocah pemanggil jiwa menghadapi sekte jahat Sembilan Krisan saat gerbang perbatasan runtuh, melindungi penduduk Lan Hai. Di dunia ini, semua kesadaran terdiri dari partikel mikroskopis, dan Lin Ye, seorang pemuda dari Lan Hai, lahir dengan konstitusi "pemanggil jiwa", menjadikannya "hotel ekspres manusia" yang tak terbantahkan di "lingkaran jiwa pengembara," terus-menerus dirasuki, menyebabkan masalah, dan melarikan diri dalam kekacauan. Setelah bertemu Chen Guo, seorang gadis dengan kemampuan supranatural untuk menundukkan "jiwa pengembara," ia memasuki organisasi supranatural Akademi Hua Jing, dan terlibat dalam konflik berusia seabad dengan sekte jahat Jepang Timur, "Sekte Sembilan Krisan." Selama waktu ini, ia menderita pengkhianatan berulang kali, kepercayaannya hancur, hingga gerbang perbatasan akan terbuka, dan seluruh kota berada dalam bahaya. Dengan tekad yang kuat, Lin Ye menghadapi klon sempurna, bertarung sampai mati untuk melindungi Lan Hai. Namun, tepat ketika pertempuran besar berakhir dan para pahlawan gugur, konspirasi baru oleh Sekte Sembilan Krisan diam-diam terungkap jauh di dalam Kunlun…
